_about: Percy Gardner (1846-1937), Oxford classical archaeologist. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): Sculptured Tombs of Hellas, clean Gutenberg; A Manual of Greek Antiquities with F. B. Jevons, second edition (Griffin, 1898), raw IA OCR (Jevons died 1936). No uids minted.  Round dz adds New Chapters in Greek History (1892).  Round ea adds A Grammar of Greek Art (1905) and its enlargement, The Principles of Greek Art (1914).
